overview:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a finished premium website illustration, landscape 1536x1024 or larger, for CX83 Labs. NOT a flyer, no page navigation, no contact details. This is a clear branching connection tree showing POSSIBLE business systems built around ChatGPT and existing apps. Palette exactly midnight navy #080E22, azure #246BFF, violet #8247F5, silver #E6EBF5. Dark seamless background, very subtle blue/violet glow behind precise thin curved connector lines. Crisp large white contemporary sans serif typography, tidy generous spacing, flat recognizable official full-color app logos in small ivory icon tiles, slight depth only. Highly legible at website section size, not a sci-fi web of wires.
Top headline left: "Your tools. Working together."
Small line below: "A few possibilities for your business."
Central top node: a simple outline people icon plus "You & your team" and below "Set direction. Review. Approve."
A vertical line flows into a wide mid-upper navy glass card with recognizable OpenAI knot symbol and text "ChatGPT + your connected tools". Beneath in smaller text: "Connected by CX83 Labs". Use CX83 Labs as ordinary text only; do not invent or draw its logo.
From this card ONE line branches into exactly THREE equally spaced vertical columns, neatly inside canvas with ample margins.
LEFT heading "Customers". Three connected compact app tiles in vertical order: official blue WordPress W circle plus "WordPress", orange HubSpot mark plus "HubSpot", multicolor Gmail M plus "Gmail". Simple bottom outcome: "Leads captured." next line "Follow ups organized."
MIDDLE heading "Marketing". Three app tiles: official multicolor Google Drive triangle plus "Google Drive", simple review checkmark icon plus "Your approval", official Buffer stack mark plus "Buffer". Beneath branch into small recognizable Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn logos in a row. Bottom outcome "Content prepared." next line "Approved posts scheduled."
RIGHT heading "Operations". First row two tiles beside each other: official Google Calendar icon plus "Calendar", official Google Sheets icon plus "Sheets". Both join a tile with official Google Drive triangle plus "Google Drive", then simple dashboard outline icon plus "Custom dashboard". Bottom outcome "Files organized." next line "Work status visible."
No node crossing. Connector lines enter node boundaries and terminate clearly; calm visual rhythm. All text spelled exactly. No tiny paragraph text, no metrics, no partner badges. Bottom small but legible line: "Example connections. We choose and test the right setup for your business." Do not show Claude, Gemini or other AI providers. Do not depict every app as a direct native ChatGPT integration; this is a CX83-designed combination of connected apps and configured workflows.
customers:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a finished premium CX83 Labs website illustration, 1536x1024 landscape. Cohesive navy #080E22 background, azure #246BFF and violet #8247F5 accent lines, silver #E6EBF5 supporting text, clean white headings. Restrained blue glowing thin curved connectors, dark rounded rectangular nodes, recognizable accurate full-color software logos on ivory square tiles. Professional, sharp, generous space, no flyers, no stock photos, no fake screenshots, no decorative wiring.
Large upper-left title "From inquiry to follow up." Small eyebrow "CUSTOMER CONNECTIONS". Subtitle "Keep the next step connected."
Main diagram is a broad clear left-to-right flow with four evenly spaced larger cards. At left, WordPress official W logo and exact label "Website inquiry", smaller text "WordPress". Arrow to orange HubSpot logo and label "Customer record", smaller text "HubSpot". Arrow to a simple people/checkmark icon and label "Your team reviews", smaller text "Choose the next step". From that third card branch neatly to two rightmost endpoint cards arranged vertically: Gmail official multicolor M with label "Email follow up" and small "Gmail"; Google Calendar official icon with label "Scheduled reminder" and small "Google Calendar". No arrow from Gmail to Calendar; these are separate branches.
Centered beneath the left-middle section, one supportive ChatGPT card with accurate OpenAI knot logo, label "ChatGPT can help", smaller line "Summarize the inquiry. Prepare a reply." Connect this card to team review with a subtle violet line. Clearly the team reviews before external email. Diagram must read effortlessly.
Below diagram two compact text statements with simple checkmarks: "One place to track the conversation." and "A clear next step for your team."
Bottom left small ordinary text "Connected by CX83 Labs" without inventing CX83 logo. Bottom center legible qualifier "Example workflow. Connections and actions are configured for your business."
No performance metrics, no implied vendor endorsement, no more than these apps. Exact readable spelling. Leave ample breathing room around every label.
marketing:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a finished premium CX83 Labs website illustration, 1536x1024 landscape. Navy #080E22 background, azure #246BFF and violet #8247F5 curved thin connectors, silver #E6EBF5 supporting copy, large clean white sans serif typography. Dark rounded cards and authentic recognizable full-color app logos on ivory square tiles. Premium crisp website diagram, calm purposeful glow, generous spacing. Not a flyer, no photo, no fake screenshots.
Upper-left eyebrow "MARKETING CONNECTIONS". Large title "From your ideas to approved posts." Subtitle "Your content. Your voice. Your approval."
Main diagram left-to-right across image with exactly five well-spaced stages:
1 recognizable multicolor Google Drive triangle tile, label "Your content", sublabel "Google Drive".
2 recognizable OpenAI knot logo tile, label "Prepare a draft", sublabel "ChatGPT".
3 simple person with checkmark icon tile, label "You review", sublabel "Edit and approve".
4 official Buffer stack logo tile, label "Schedule", sublabel "Buffer".
5 branches into three stacked recognizable Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn logo tiles, each with its correct name. This last grouped stage is labeled "Your channels".
Every connector flows cleanly between node edges. Approval is a prominent human gate before Buffer. Make branching right side visually clear. Do not repeat extra platforms, do not omit approval.
Bottom spacious band contains three short outcome labels "Reuse your existing material." "Keep your message consistent." "Plan what goes out next."
Footer in legible smaller text: "Example workflow. We choose and test the right setup for your business." and small ordinary "Connected by CX83 Labs". No invented CX83 logo, no promises of results, no partnership badge. Maintain high-quality exact spelling and uncluttered composition.
operations:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a finished premium CX83 Labs website illustration, 1536x1024 landscape. Deep navy #080E22, azure #246BFF, violet #8247F5, silver #E6EBF5. Crisp white sans serif text, thin elegant blue/violet curved branching connectors, restrained glow, dark rounded app cards, authentic recognizable full-color logos on small ivory tiles. Same tasteful visual language as a CX83 Labs connected tools web graphic. NO flyer masthead, no photo, no technical architecture jargon.
Upper-left eyebrow "OPERATIONS CONNECTIONS". Large headline "See the work. Keep it moving." Subtitle "Bring files, schedules and progress into view."
Diagram: Three left source cards arranged vertically with official brand icons and exact labels: "Google Drive" sublabel "Files and documents"; "Google Sheets" sublabel "Tasks and progress"; "Google Calendar" sublabel "Dates and commitments". Three clean connectors join ONE large center node labeled "Your connected workspace", with smaller text "Designed around your process" and a clear simple four-square dashboard line icon. Ordinary small label under this central node "Connected by CX83 Labs". Do not invent a CX83 logo.
Center node branches into THREE clearly separate right cards stacked vertically:
Top card has OpenAI knot symbol and exact label "Ask ChatGPT", sublabel "Find context and prepare updates".
Middle card has dashboard outline icon and label "View your dashboard", sublabel "See the status of the work".
Bottom card has team/check icon and label "Review the next step", sublabel "Your team decides what happens".
This is a conceptual possibilities tree, not a promise of automatic direct native integration. No looping or crossing lines. Every input and output label readable.
Footer separated with generous space: "Example connections. We choose and test the right setup for your business."
Keep composition focused and balanced, enough whitespace for 7 cards, plain English, no claims of savings, no vendor endorsement.
